trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: The board voted for 5 to 2 and told that costs would rise.
trap.right: The board voted 5–2 and told the board that costs would rise.
trap.why: Português “votou por 5 a 2”; inglês voted 5–2, sem preposição, e tell leva objeto pessoal.

fix.wrong: The chair told that costs rise.
fix.right: The chair said that costs would rise.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “The chair said to the board, ‘Costs will rise.’” (told)
rewrite.answer: The chair told the board that costs would rise.
